notablePrerequisites:
Hellkite Charger does not have summoning sickness.
Bear Umbra attached to Hellkite Charger.
You control lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{R}{R}.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Hellkite Charger.
description:
Declare Hellkite Charger as attacker.
Bear Umbra and Hellkite Charger triggers.
Resolve the Bear Umbra's trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger's trigger, choosing to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
